decisions.reason: The video guide remains required and its current state already records that one selected video serves all users; removing tutorial images does not change those video-guide attributes.
Removing the separate tutorial-image localization method does not cancel or narrow localization of Android application content that remains in the app.
Android RTL layout support is independent of whether tutorial images require localization.
Removing the separate tutorial-image localization method does not cancel or narrow localization of iOS application content that remains in the app.
Locale-appropriate social-media destinations remain required and are unrelated to tutorial-image presentation.
The source removes a tutorial-image localization requirement but does not change the Android size-optimization goal or report an implementation effect on app size.
iOS signing readiness is independent of tutorial-image localization.
The source does not change the iOS size-optimization goal or establish any size-related implementation outcome.
iOS RTL layout support remains required independently of tutorial-image localization.
Removing tutorial-image localization does not alter the required iOS Thinning distribution method.
Visibility of the Scoliometer title is unrelated to tutorial images or their localization.
Android OS, API, and dependency modernization remains valid unchanged after removal of tutorial-image localization.
